name: answerPatientFAQ
shortDescription: Provides answers to common patient questions based on hospital policies and a knowledge base.
description:
Overview

Responds to frequently asked patient questions by querying hospital policies, general medical information, or a dedicated knowledge base.

Intended use

Called by the patient-facing UI or a patient-facing chatbot to provide instant answers. It receives the question asked by the patient.

Logic

  1. Retrieve relevant HospitalSetting data for general policies and operational information.
  2. Query the KnowledgeContainer for relevant FAQs or medical information based on the params.question.
  3. (Hypothetical AI step): Utilize an internal AI service (e.ai., ctx.ai.answer_question) to process the question and retrieved information to formulate a coherent answer.
  4. Return the generated answer to the patient's question.

Entities

  • HospitalSetting
  • KnowledgeContainer
